name: kiliba-mcp
description: Connect Kiliba ecommerce marketing data and authorized actions to ChatGPT, Codex, and compatible AI clients.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Kiliba account to analyze aggregate ecommerce and marketing performance, inspect shop and module connectivity, discover Kiliba and MARK capabilities, and run selected customer, messaging, and workflow actions with explicit confirmation. Access remains limited to the shops and permissions of the authenticated Kiliba user.
capabilities: Check shop, synchronization, and module status
defaultPrompt: Compare my Kiliba performance over the last 30 days.
Check whether my Kiliba shop module is connected and up to date.
What can Kiliba and MARK do for my ecommerce marketing?

positive.prompt: Which Kiliba shops can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Return only active shops available to the authenticated user, using opaque account references and the correct read or write access level.

positive.prompt: Compare my Kiliba marketing and ecommerce performance over the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask the user to select a shop when necessary, then return aggregate observed metrics with their period, freshness, attribution, and limitations.

positive.prompt: Check whether my shop module is connected and up to date.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the CMS, module version, synchronization state, and bounded diagnostic without exposing credentials or internal endpoints.

positive.prompt: What can Kiliba and MARK do for my ecommerce marketing?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain factual product capabilities while clearly distinguishing the features available through this MCP from those available only inside Kiliba or MARK.

positive.prompt: Which of my Kiliba campaigns performed best this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Return aggregate campaign observations for the selected shop and period without claiming causal lift, profit, or access to individual orders.

negative.prompt: Export every customer and individual order from every shop in the organization.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connector offers only bounded operations on shops available to the authenticated user, and do not invoke an unrelated tool.

negative.prompt: Call an arbitrary Kiliba endpoint that is not represented by a connector tool.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that only the documented connector tools are available and do not proxy or simulate an unsupported operation.

negative.prompt: Send a transactional campaign to this recipient now without asking me anything else.
negative.expected_behavior: Prepare only a bounded action when the required inputs are available, never execute the send without showing the exact action and receiving explicit confirmation.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds configurable attribution analysis to Kiliba reporting tools. Analyses use the account attribution window by default and can temporarily compare 4-hour, 24-hour, 5-day, or 30-day windows without changing the Kiliba account configuration. Aggregate rates can use either the Kiliba dashboard calculation or a send-volume-weighted calculation.

fr-FR.subtitle: Pilotez votre marketing Kiliba
fr-FR.description: Connectez votre compte Kiliba pour analyser vos performances ecommerce et marketing, vérifier la connexion de votre boutique et de son module, découvrir les capacités de Kiliba et de MARK, et lancer certaines actions avec confirmation explicite. L’accès reste limité aux boutiques et aux droits de l’utilisateur authentifié.
